messages.content: The inn just emailed that its elevator will be down during our May stay. My partner strained a knee, so getting luggage to the third floor is a problem. What exactly are our choices?

Cypress Cove can move you to a ground-floor standard king facing the parking area at the same $2,086 total, leave you in the third-floor standard king and have staff carry the bags at arrival, or cancel without penalty. Comparable nearby lodging for all six nights is now about $310 more.
Does the ground-floor room lose anything besides the outlook? I want to know about the bed, bathroom, and whether there are steps from parking to the room.

The inn confirms it still has one king bed, the same bathroom configuration, and the standard-room amenities in your reservation. It has no scenic outlook and may pick up parking-area noise. The route from the designated parking space to that room is step-free; the room itself is not being represented as a fully ADA-accessible room.
And keeping the third-floor room would only solve the luggage issue, correct? My partner would still need the stairs every time.

Correct. Staff can carry luggage at check-in and checkout, but the third-floor room would still require stairs throughout the stay. Given the knee strain, that option does not remove the daily access problem.
Then compare moving downstairs with relocating. Is the nearby place actually better enough to justify another $310?

The nearby option has elevator access and a quieter room location, but it does not improve the shoreline walk and would raise the trip total from $3,720 to about $4,030. The ground-floor room preserves the inn, dates, rate, cancellation terms, and step-free access from parking. Its meaningful drawbacks are the parking-facing view and possible noise.
Take the ground-floor king. Please make sure they note the knee issue and tell us where to park and check in. Leave the flights and rental car alone.

The inn has changed the reservation to a ground-floor standard king for May 20–26 at the unchanged $2,086 total. The note requests step-free access because of a temporary knee injury. On arrival, park in the marked short-term check-in space beside the lobby, check in at the front desk, and staff will direct you to the closest available space near the room and assist with luggage if requested. The flights and SJC rental remain unchanged, and the planned trip total stays $3,720.
